criterion: which domain of assistant functionality the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Alarms and Timers
categories.definition: Managing time-based alerts and countdowns, including setting, modifying, deleting, querying, pausing, or resuming.

categories.name: Reminders
categories.definition: Managing notifications for specific tasks or events, including setting, modifying, deleting, or querying.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Sending, receiving, and managing calls, messages, and video messages, including initiating, sending content, managing participants, and retrieving history.

categories.name: Media Playback
categories.definition: Playing and controlling audio or video content, including playing songs, albums, playlists, switching tracks, setting defaults, and controlling output.

categories.name: Information Query
categories.definition: Retrieving general facts, definitions, recipes, calculations, or specific details about non-event/non-news topics.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: Querying current or forecasted weather conditions, including temperature, precipitation, wind, warnings, and general forecasts.

categories.name: News
categories.definition: Retrieving current or historical news headlines and stories, including general news, specific topics, local news, and historical events.

categories.name: People and Contacts
categories.definition: Querying information about people, their relationships, affiliations, or contact details from a social context.

categories.name: Events and Activities
categories.definition: Discovering, recommending, or querying about social events, entertainment, or things to do.

categories.name: Presence and Availability
categories.definition: Checking or updating one's own or others' online status or general availability.
